method: Static instruction/data decoding of the shipped PS2 ELF; no original PS2 execution claimed.

decoder.limitation: R5900 LQC2/SQC2 are printed as BBIT aliases; some R5900 scalar FPU operations remain raw bytes. Decisions below use the actual instruction words and scalar branches.

action151.conditional: If Pawn.Controller casts to SPlayerController AND controller byte0xC28 bit0 is set, set Pawn byte0x319 bit3; otherwise clear Pawn byte0x319 bit3.
action151.controllerClassCast: 0x2ABC80 checks UObject.Class+0x24 and UClass.Super+0x28 against SPlayerController static class0x511990.
action151.controllerFlagName: source global855937/ref1668; complete layout proof is controller-repos-flag-layout-proof.json

physics.additionalPhysics: Pawn+0x319 bit3; exactly the flag assigned by action151
physics.timeGuard: Return if Level.TimeSeconds < Pawn+0xAD4; else write Now+dt (0x297360..0x297388).
physics.delta: Target-Location; zero Delta.Z if abs(Delta.Z)<5 or additionalPhysics (0x29738C..0x2973E8).
physics.movement: Move by normalized Delta * speed * dt, clamped to Delta if remaining distance <= step or <=0.1 (0x2973EC..0x2974BC).
physics.yaw: FixedTurn current yaw toward target-facing rotation, 3000 units per call; pitch/roll zero (0x2974E8..0x29755C).
physics.additionalTrue: Rotate with MoveActor zero translation; set vDeltaMove=(Move.X,Move.Y,0)/dt; call virtual+0x110 walking(dt,0) (0x297578..0x29761C).
physics.additionalFalse: Clear Actor byte0x315 bit4, MoveActor with full3D move, optional slide after an actor hit, restore Actor byte0x315 bit4 (0x297624..0x2977F0). The bit is the bCollideWorld flag by equivalence to the decoded PC function and source movement branch; this proof retains the raw offset/mask.
physics.arrival: Recompute Delta, same Z deadband/additional behavior; require distance<1 AND exact16bit target/current yaw equality, then call Controller event global0x20C0/TopSynchro (0x297898..0x2979A4).
physics.endReposition: 0x2979E0..0x297B60: full target-Location delta, zeroZ only with additionalphysics; temporarily clear worldcollisionbit, MoveActor full delta/finalyaw, restore worldcollisiontrue, zeroVelocity/Acceleration. No bNoReposAtEnd early return exists in this source function.
physics.leaveMode11: 0x297F44..0x297F64 calls EndPhysRepositionning on leaving mode11 only when Rolebyte0x301==4.
physics.conclusion: There is no source5uu arrival tolerance. Source action151 conditionally chooses collision/walking behavior, unlike the unconditional PC action148 additional-physics setting.
